description: This script initializes an SQLite database for the medical_prescription_database project. It resolves the database path from environment variables or defaults, runs migrations via an external migration module, and generates connection info and visualization environment variable files.

methods.name: str get_db_path()
methods.description: Returns the SQLite database file path, using the SQLITE_DB environment variable or defaulting to 'myapp.db'.

methods.name: None write_connection_info(db_path: str)
methods.description: Writes the SQLite connection details to 'db_connection.txt' for developer reference.

methods.name: None write_visualizer_env(db_path: str)
methods.description: Creates or updates 'db_visualizer/sqlite.env' with the absolute path to the database for visualization tools.

methods.name: None run_migrations()
methods.description: Runs database migrations by invoking the 'migrate' function from the external 'db_migrate' module.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Coordinates the initialization process: resolves the DB path, runs migrations, and writes helper files.
